label: Publication Status
description: The lifecycle state of a reference-data scheme itself -- whether it's still being drafted, actively governing one or more properties, or deprecated in favor of something else. Distinct from a single value's own `deprecated` flag: a scheme can stay published while one of its values is retired.

values.label: Draft
values.definition: The scheme is still being defined and does not yet constrain any concept property.

values.label: Published
values.definition: The scheme is stable and in active use, constraining one or more concept properties.

values.label: Deprecated
values.definition: The scheme is no longer recommended for new use, though existing data may still reference its values.
